buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS FOR DISTRIBUTION OF BLANKETS AND WOODE N BURNING STOVES 1. Blanket shall be premium heavy-duty winter-grade, specifically suitable for prolonged outdoor/field use in severe cold-weather conditions, with adequat e thermal insulation and heat-retention capability. 2. Each blanket shall have finished dimensions of 220 cm × 150 cm, with a dimensional tolerance of ±2%, uniform throughout and free from distortion, exc essive shrinkage or irregular edges. 3. Blanket shall be manufactured from high-quality wool/wool-blend or equ

ivalent high-performance thermal material, having good tensile strength, abrasi on resistance, dimensional stability and heat-retention characteristics. Material shall be suitable for repeated outdoor use. 4. Finished blanket weight shall be not less than 2.5 kg per blanket. Blanke t shall have adequate fabric density/GSM and thermal mass commensurate with its intended use in severe winter conditions. 5. Fabric shall have uniform thickness, density, weave/construction and ap pearance throughout. No significant thin patches, weak portions, exposed filling or variation affecting thermal performance shall be permissible. 6. All seams shall be executed using heavy-duty industrial stitching. Doubl e/reinforced stitching shall be provided at corners, edges and other stress-beari ng locations to withstand repeated handling and use. 7. All four edges shall be properly bound/overlocked and reinforced. Finishi ng shall prevent fraying, opening of seams and loss/exposure of filling material during repeated use and washing/cleaning. 8. Blankets shall be free from loose threads, stains, holes, tears, manufact uring defects, uneven stitching, exposed filling, unacceptable odour, colour irre gularity or any other defect affecting serviceability. Random inspection of suppli ed quantity may be carried out before acceptance. 9. Each blanket shall be individually packed in suitable moisture-resistant and transportation-safe packaging, adequately protecting it from dust, moisture , contamination and physical damage during transportation and storage. 10. Stove shall be a heavy-duty portable wood-burning heating stove suitable for repeated operation under cold climatic and outdoor/field conditions, with stable construction and adequate thermal efficiency. 11. Main body shall be fabricated from minimum 3 mm thick heavy-gauge mild steel/steel sheet, suitably reinforced at stress and heat-affected areas and capable of withstanding repeated heating and cooling cycles without significant deformation.

12. Firebox shall be fully enclosed and fabricated from heat-resistant heavy- gauge material suitable for seasoned firewood and sustained high operating te mperatures. Construction shall minimise uncontrolled escape of smoke and em bers during normal operation. 13. A robust removable metal ash tray of adequate thickness shall be provid ed for convenient collection and disposal of ash. Ash tray shall withstand repeat ed thermal exposure without premature deformation or failure. 14. All welded joints shall be continuous, strong and properly finished. Weld s shall be free from cracks, pinholes, excessive porosity, incomplete fusion, shar p projections and other defects affecting structural integrity or safe operation. 15. Stove shall have a stable base suitable for placement on reasonably lev el outdoor surfaces. There shall be no sharp exposed edges, unstable supports or construction defects likely to affect safe handling during normal use. 16. All supplied stoves shall conform uniformly to the approved technical sp ecifications and sample, wherever an approved sample is part of the procureme nt process. Significant variation in construction, material thickness or workmans hip shall not be accepted. 17. The purchaser shall have the right to inspect the material before accept ance. Any item found defective, damaged, under-specification, materially differ ent from the offered specifications or inferior in workmanship shall be liable for rejection and replacement by the supplier at no additional cost. 18. The supplier shall provide a minimum warranty of 3 years for blankets a nd 1 year for wooden-burning stoves from the date of acceptance/supply. Any manufacturing defect arising during the warranty period shall be rectified/repla ced by the supplier at no additional cost, subject to normal use. 19. Where required by the purchaser, the supplier shall submit a representa tive sample/specimen for technical inspection and approval before bulk supply. Bulk-supplied items shall conform to the approved sample in material, construct ion, workmanship and general quality. 20. The bidder shall clearly indicate manufacturer/model, material, dimensions, weight and warranty details in the technical bid wherever applicabl

e. Unsupported claims or deviation from the stipulated minimum requirements s hall be liable for technical rejection. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
